channel.title: Texas Standard – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Texas Standard – Bias and Credibility (texasstandard.org)

item.title: As Big Bend area border walls move forward, local landowners gear up for a fight
item.description: Advocates are rushing to help landowners with legal aid in sparsely populated rural areas along the Rio Grande in the path of the border wall. The federal government's efforts to contact landowners about the project has hit a snag due to complicated land ownership.

item.title: New research and technology hopes to aid in wildfire recovery for Texas cattle ranchers
item.description: A study is starting soon from Texas Tech University researchers within the Department of Natural Resource Management, utilizing new technology to study rangeland recovery two years after the devastating Smokehouse Creek Fire.

item.title: ‘Stay focused on the mission’: Film shares lessons from pioneering ‘Spacewoman’ Eileen Collins
item.description: The documentary, in limited theatrical release now, features not just her time at NASA, but her journey there and how her family coped with her dangerous missions.

item.title: Texas Standard for March 24, 2026: How Texas plans to power its AI data center boom
item.description: In the next few years, Texas could have more data centers than anywhere else in the world. The state will need energy to power those plants and several companies have plans to build gas-fired power plants to meet the need.

item.title: Border wall plans changed to avoid Big Bend Ranch State Park
item.description: The U.S. Border Patrol said Monday that Big Bend Ranch State Park may be spared from border wall construction. The news came after federal authorities briefed Big Bend area officials on border wall plans in recent days.

item.title: How an Afghan man who aided U.S. military forces died in ICE custody in Texas
item.description: Mohammad Nazeer Paktiawal, 41, died March 14 in a Dallas hospital, the day after ICE arrested him outside his home. He was the 24th person to die in ICE custody since last October.

item.title: Artist transforms 2026 FIFA World Cup soccer ball into Juneteenth tribute in Galveston
item.description: Visit Galveston, the marketing organization for the island, received the five large soccer balls as part of its partnership with Houston’s World Cup host committee to promote the island as a destination for World Cup visitors. Each ball is being painted by an artist to show off different parts of the island and its history.

item.title: Texas Supreme Court weighs constitutional beach access in case against SpaceX
item.description: The nine justices traveled to the Rio Grande Valley earlier this month to hear oral arguments.

item.title: The drama backstage: How a Miami singer came to Dallas Opera’s rescue with minutes to spare
item.description: When a lead singer called in sick before showtime, the race began to replace him.

item.title: How Texas could soon have more AI data centers than anywhere else in the world
item.description: Pacifico Energy and other energy companies are rushing to build private power plants across the Lone Star State.
